title: EAPOL COPP rules are not getting installed when other features also try to use same trap group. Working only with MACSEC.
author: vijaya-ops
body:
We are trying to place PAC functionality in the Sonic community.

As part of this, we edited the copp_json.j2 file as below
      "ip2me": {
            "trap_ids": "ip2me",
            "trap_group": "queue1_group1",
            "always_enabled": "true"
        },
        "macsec": {
            "trap_ids": "eapol",
            "trap_group": "queue4_group1"
        },
        "nat": {
            "trap_ids": "src_nat_miss,dest_nat_miss",
            "trap_group": "queue1_group2"
        },
        "sflow": {
            "trap_group": "queue2_group1",
            "trap_ids": "sample_packet"
        },
        "pac": {
            "trap_ids": "eapol",
            "trap_group": "queue4_group1"
        }

The issue currently we are facing is that if macsec is enabled , then only eapol frames are coming up. Same is the case with feature disable.

We would like to have the eapol frames to come up even if any one of the features is enabled. Similarly only when the both features get disabled, then only the eapol copp functionality should get disabled.

Also as an experiment, when macsec entry is removed from the above copp_cfg.j2 and enable pac feature, then we were able to see  the eapol rule in the respective trap group.

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/18226

**What I did**
Fix coppmgr when there are multiple feature tables using same trap.

In addition fixed the following issues
1) When a new feature is added which is not present during the init, the copp entry will not get programmed. 
2) When a copp trap attribute is set, it overrides the other existing attributes

**Why I did it**
Fix copp issues

**How I verified it**
Added UT to verify
